en.title: Fortnite's Nikki Skin Sparks Horror Fan Boycott Calls Over Controversial Origins
en.summary: A new Fortnite skin based on the character Nikki from the horror film Obsession has ignited a fierce debate. Some players are calling for a boycott due to the character's traumatic storyline.
en.body:
Fortnite's Fortnitemares 2026 event is set to welcome a chilling new addition with the arrival of **Nikki Freeman** from the surprise 2026 horror hit, **Obsession**. However, this collaboration has quickly become a focal point for controversy, with a vocal segment of the player base expressing strong disapproval and calling for a boycott.

The skin, featuring **Nikki Freeman** as portrayed by actress **Inde Navarrette**, was officially revealed on October 20th. While **Obsession** has garnered significant popularity, even ranking as one of the most searched Halloween costumes this year, the decision to include **Nikki** as a playable character in a video game has deeply unsettled some fans. This reaction stems directly from **Nikki**'s harrowing experience in the film, where her body is possessed by a malevolent entity while her consciousness is trapped, forced to witness unspeakable acts committed in her name. Compounding this trauma, the character is also subjected to non-consensual intimacy by another character, Bear, who is aware of the possession.

## The Heart of the Controversy

The core of the backlash centers on the portrayal of **Nikki** as a victim of severe trauma, including sexual assault, being translated into a purchasable cosmetic item within a widely accessible battle royale game. Critics argue that turning such a vulnerable character into an avatar for players, regardless of the intent, trivializes her suffering and disrespects the film's narrative. The inclusion of a special emote, which recreates a tense scene from the movie, and the character's signature frown, further amplify these concerns for those who feel the collaboration is insensitive. Online discussions are rife with players expressing their discomfort, with some stating they will refuse to purchase the skin or even boycott the game during the **Fortnitemares** event.

## Community Divided

While a boycott is being advocated by some, the **Fortnite** community remains divided. Many players are excited about the **Obsession** collaboration, seeing it as a fitting addition to the **Fortnitemares** festivities. The film's popularity and the visual design of the **Nikki** skin have undoubtedly appealed to a large portion of the player base. Leaks have also suggested the possibility of a bloody variant of the **Nikki** skin, though this remains unconfirmed. The debate highlights the ongoing challenge for platforms like **Fortnite** to navigate the complexities of pop culture, ensuring that licensed content resonates with fans without causing offense or trivializing serious themes.

## What's Next

The **Nikki Freeman** skin and its associated cosmetics are scheduled to drop in the **Fortnite** Item Shop on October 21st at 8 PM ET. The exact pricing and full list of bundle contents have not yet been officially confirmed by Epic Games, but details are expected to emerge closer to the release time. Players will have the opportunity to acquire the skin as part of the ongoing **Fortnitemares 2026** event.
